The Data Hub's existing Page controls edit composition and reporting, while figure
values remain compiled. This increment moves data-authoring work into a separate
plugin project and establishes a small framework-neutral host boundary.

It adds a private electricity editor, strict source/reuse/matched-series schema,
SHA-256-bound independent validation and editorial approval, stale-version refusal,
a trusted authentication/transaction port, and a React route reference. A read-only
inventory retains all 18 legacy shapes. The other 17 profiles, real Boardwalk storage,
reader/export parity and atomic public publication remain explicit follow-ups.

Validation: locked installs; TypeScript and React-wrapper checks; input/workflow/
adapter/inventory suites; desktop/mobile browser flow and axe checks; policy,
bootstrap unit checks, dependency audit and package inspection. Hosted CI and
independent review must pass on this PR. New tests are listed in tests/; no upstream
tests or baselines were changed. No production CMS, editorial values or release
controls changed, and no merge, deployment or npm publication is included.
